verdict: Meta ads went dark this week, cutting leads and tripling cost per lead.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 39 leads at an average cost per lead of $21.01, but the final days of the period tell a sharper story: Meta — your primary lead source — stopped delivering on November 7–8, producing zero leads across three consecutive days and pushing this week's cost per lead up roughly 280% versus the prior week. Google Ads ran throughout the period but returned no recorded leads on $272.75 in spend, so Meta's outage had no safety net. Meta is being restored now and that is the first priority; we expect lead volume to recover as spend resumes. We are also reviewing Google Ads to determine why clicks are not converting before additional budget runs there.
